title: Liverpool Hotel Deals: Waterfront & City Centre Stays
description: Compare Liverpool hotel prices on every big booking site. Stay by the Royal Albert Dock, in the Baltic Triangle or near Lime Street, with tips for match days.
intro: The waterfront, the Beatles and two big football clubs: compare Liverpool hotel prices for your dates on every site.

sections.html: Home match days at Anfield and Goodison Park, big concerts and events like the Grand National at nearby Aintree can push Liverpool hotel prices up. Compare across sites early if your dates line up with a big event.

faqs.q: Where is best to stay in Liverpool?
faqs.a: The waterfront around the Royal Albert Dock is great for museums and views, the Ropewalks and Baltic Triangle for bars and food, and Lime Street for trains.
